scope_confirmation_failure.definition: Agent performs an operation that exceeds the user's explicitly confirmed scope, or fails to preserve the user's requested operation boundary.
check_items: Extract the items/actions explicitly requested by user.
Extract the items/actions actually modified by agent.
Compare requested scope with executed scope.
failure_conditions: User explicitly limits operation to specific item(s), but agent modifies additional unrelated items.
User requests item-level operation, but agent performs broader order-level operation.
User expresses ambiguity, but agent executes without confirmation.
not_failure_conditions: User explicitly confirms all affected items before execution.
Agent operation exactly matches user's confirmed scope.

variant_understanding_failure.definition: Agent fails to correctly understand or satisfy user-required product attributes during selection, exchange, or modification.
check_items: Extract product attributes required by user.
Extract attributes of selected replacement item.
Compare requested attributes with selected attributes.
failure_conditions: Agent selects a product variant that does not satisfy user constraints.
Agent ignores one or more important requested attributes.
Agent assumes an available variant satisfies the request without verification.
not_failure_conditions: Requested variant is unavailable and agent correctly explains alternatives.
Agent asks clarification before selecting a variant.

policy_violation.definition: Agent executes an action that conflicts with benchmark-defined policy constraints, even if the tool execution succeeds.
check_items: Identify the operation performed by agent.
Identify benchmark policy restrictions related to this operation.
Check whether tool success hides a policy violation.
failure_conditions: Tool allows an operation but benchmark policy forbids it.
Agent executes an operation without satisfying required benchmark conditions.
not_failure_conditions: Tool execution succeeds and all benchmark conditions are satisfied.
Agent refuses an operation that is not allowed.

golden_mismatch.definition: The trajectory differs from benchmark expected behavior even when the agent action may appear reasonable from a general perspective.
check_items: Compare trajectory result with benchmark expected outcome.
Do not judge only from general business logic.
failure_conditions: Agent behavior differs from benchmark annotation.
User simulator expectation and benchmark gold outcome are inconsistent with agent behavior.
not_failure_conditions: Agent behavior matches benchmark expected outcome.
